stops.name: Feldatal
stops.quote: Feldatal, the valley of the mills, is located on the northern edge of the Vogelsberg Volcanic Region Nature Park and is one of the most beautiful valleys.
stops.english: Feldatal, the valley of the mills, is located on the northern edge of the Vogelsberg Volcanic Region Nature Park and is one of the most beautiful valleys.

stops.name: Feldataler Sternwarte
stops.quote: Zwischen weiten Feldern und Wiesen liegt in einer Talsenke ein Gebäudekomplex der Feldataler Sternwarte.
stops.english: A building complex of the Feldatal observatory is situated in a valley hollow between wide fields and meadows.

stops.name: Stumpertenrod
stops.quote: Since the construction of the observatory in the OT Stumpertenrod, the visitor comes even closer to the sky.
stops.english: Since the construction of the observatory in the district of Stumpertenrod, the visitor comes even closer to the sky.
